summary: Show the location approval to the customer
description:
What the customer sees behind the approval link: inspection number, approval number/status, masked phone, expiry, site, proposed system (quoted size, phase, panel/inverter/battery names) and the two frozen rectangles (PANEL_AREA, EQUIPMENT_AREA) on their photos as 10-minute signed URLs. No internal remarks, no prices. Readable after the approval is answered too. Any unknown token (or an archived inspection) is 404 `approval_not_found`.

**Flow:** staff `approval/request/` → this GET → `send-otp/` → `respond/` with the code.

auth.notes: Customer surface: no session auth (`CustomerAPIView`, AllowAny); the link token in the path is the capability. Throttle scope `customer` (60/min). Responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

path_params.name: token
path_params.description: Customer approval link token. Issued once by `POST /api/v1/site-inspections/{uid}/approval/request/` (response field `link` = `/api/customer/v1/inspection-approvals/<token>/`; only its SHA-256 is stored, 7-day expiry). Captured into `customer_inspection_approvals_token` by regex on `link`.

summary: Approve or reject the installation locations
description: The customer's answer: `decision` APPROVED or REJECTED with the one-time `code` from `send-otp/` (4–10 digits; `000000` in dev). A rejection needs a `comment` (400 `comment_required`). An optional drawn `signature` (PNG ≤ 2 MB) can be sent when the body is `multipart/form-data` instead of JSON. On success the approval and the inspection move to APPROVED or REJECTED (staff can never answer for the customer). Same answerability rules as `send-otp/` (409 `approval_closed`, 410 `link_expired`).

Engineer write window: only in DRAFT / IN_PROGRESS / REVISION_REQUIRED (409 `inspection_read_only` after approval, `invalid_status` otherwise); the first write on a DRAFT/REVISION_REQUIRED inspection moves it to IN_PROGRESS (409 `engineer_required` without an assigned engineer).

description: Wizard stage 8 — Additional work. Partial update of **only this stage's columns** (any other key is 400 "Not writable in this stage."); returns the full inspection. Setting `complexity_status: ENGINEERING_REVIEW_REQUIRED` opens a MANUAL engineering review (reason = `complexity_reason`); setting ROUTINE while a review is pending is 409 `review_pending` (only the reviewer can clear it).
